crossRefs.note: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

translations.web: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day, but have kept the charge given you by the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
translations.asv: ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of Jehovah your God.
